messages:
alex: hitting a provisioning block when trying to create an A100 nodegroup in eu-north-1. Console error: identity_verification_failed, API returns 403.
marta: which AWS account? new EU account or prod?
alex: redwood-eu-prod. Billing page shows: Payment method pending / verification required. AWS portal has a doc upload prompt.
billing-bot: Automatic: \"Business verification required: upload company registration (English), VAT document, and a recent bank statement. 3DS auth failed on the card. Contact payments@ to retry.\" :warning:
samir: is this our infra account or a customer landing account? Did we already send Articles + VAT when the account was created?
olga: it's our infra account. Corporate card triggered extra checks with the EU acquirer. I submitted docs to internal ticket #1827 but AWS wants them in their support portal.
alex: AWS CLI snippet when CreateNodeGroup failed:
```
ClientError: Request blocked: identity_verification_failed
RequestId: a1b2c3d4-xxxx
HTTPStatusCode: 403
```
marta: pinging sales-ops to re-submit via the AM channel. For eu-north they often want notarized translations and matching billing address info.
sales-ops: opening an enterprise case with AM now. Case 8912345678. Asking for expedited verification for provisioning-only work so we can reserve a small A100 pool for benchmarks. Uploaded: Articles_of_Incorporation_EN.pdf, VAT_registration.pdf, BankStatement_redacted.pdf.
finance: confirmed card auth failed due to a 3DS challenge decline from issuer. We're working with the acquirer to whitelist the merchant for infra spend.
legal: if AWS demands notarized translations we can coordinate with our notary firm; need a POA if they ask for beneficial owner docs.
alex: any short-term workaround? If AWS blocks at account level, region switches won't help.
olga: we can try a different internal billing account as a fallback, but that requires reconfiguring the VPC peering and secrets. Not great for latency/benchmark fidelity.
samir: can AM temporarily whitelist provisioning for node creation while docs under review? anyone with the AM contact?
sales-ops: AM replied: they can grant limited provisioning quota for small test instances after we provide a scanned corporate ID + letter from payments@ confirming card holder and last4. ETA 24-48h after we submit those items.
alex: I'll hold off automated retries to avoid repeated auth failures. cloud-provision-bot, pause requeues?
cloud-provision-bot: Deploy attempt recorded at 1774600001: CreateNodeGroup -> blocked (identity_verification_failed). Next retry scheduled at 1774686400 unless status changes. Suspending retries per request.
marta: legal + sales-ops, please confirm notarization timeline. Finance, can you supply the bank letter with last4 plus a payments@ confirmation email? That sped things up last time.
finance: will request an issuer letter and resend auth attempt once AWS confirms allowed acquirer flow.
alex: sample invoice stub to send if AM requests one:
```
Invoice
Customer: Redwood Inference AB
VAT: SE12345678901
Address: Strandvagen 12, Stockholm
Amount: EUR 0 (reservation)
```
sales-ops: AM asked for proof of beneficial owner and notarized translation of Articles. Uploading now and asking for an interim provisioning allowance for test quota only. Case 8912345678 updated.
billing-bot: Ticket #1827 updated: docs uploaded, status=under review. Processing time: 1-3 business days.
olga: I'll also create a tracking ticket for the eu-north-1 A100 pool with cost estimate and burn rate so we can prioritize when verified.
marta: thanks. once AM confirms interim quota I'll post permitted instance types and limits here so infra can plan.
alex: appreciated. holding on runs until we see VERIFIED or a confirmed AM note. :thumbsup:
